tile.name: Flashing tools
tile.desc: Flash firmware over USB from a browser

menu.title: Flashing tools
menu.subtitle: Put firmware onto radios and boards over USB, from Chrome or Edge on a computer.
menu.about: The web flasher flashes ESP32 radios. FreeOCD flashes ARM chips through a debug probe. The serial terminal shows the start of a device. The hosted pages need the HTTPS address of the box. Web Serial and WebUSB need a secure context. A downloaded local file also works.
